suite: W7 default Bot workspace: DSH top workspace selector follows Bot settings
implementation: nisse/packages/host-integration/lib/index.js: reads DSH_HOME/bot/config.json -> agent.workspace on every Bot session; registers that directory through the official ctx.workspaceRegistry.create (idempotent, prepended) so DSH shows it in 工作区; bridge workspaceDir/agent cwd/preflight root all use the same value.

apps/desktop/src/bot-runtime.ts: managed profile layer carries workspaceDir + LLM provider/model + permission preset + host-integration entry; regenerated on every start and Bot settings save (user-authored patch lines preserved).
apps/desktop/src/main.ts: Bot settings save -> botRuntime.applyConfig(config) (profile layer + voice gateway restart).

freshInstall.dshHome: /tmp/whalegirl-fresh (new DSH_HOME, empty workspace/session store; desktop profile copied from the installed DSH profile so providers exist)

existingProfile.note: On an existing DSH home with prior sessions, DSH restores the saved session selection; the Bot workspace is registered and visible in 工作区, and the Bot bridge session runs in it. The fresh-install path above is the acceptance case for '新会话进入该 workspace'.
existingProfile.observed: test profile with prior default workspace showed MyBotWorkspace in the sidebar while the old saved session stayed selected

reproduce: 1. DSH_HOME=/tmp/<fresh>; copy an installed profiles/desktop and .credentials.yaml
3. install the first-party host-integration bundle into the desktop profile (apps/desktop bot-runtime prepare does this in the packaged shell)
4. launch the desktop shell; host log prints 'bot workspace ready'; the DSH composer workspace chip shows <dir> and the new session is created inside it
5. change agent.workspace, relaunch: the chip shows the new directory
